text:
alex: heads-up — Pilot A and Pilot B iced their Dedicated cutover. main ask: concise per-route economics + a compact error-slice view before they sign contracts. asking for a small unblock this quarter. :cold_face:

maya: thanks. we should scope a pragmatic beta: route cost table (24h), error-slice (top 3 error classes per route), and a one-click traced-request link from the route row. no full-span histograms for v1.

tony: sounds doable. sampling approach idea: deterministic per-route reservoir with sticky sample ids so traces across services tie back to the route. will spike 36h to validate bias.

ben: infra considerations: need a short-lived validation pipeline (48-72h) to compare online attribution against nightly batch. also a small billing-tag handshake to ensure route_id propagates. ops flagged dependency but said they'll prioritize with a ticket.

sarah: customers want a short acceptance checklist they can run: data freshness (<15m), route delta vs nightly baseline within 8% for top routes, trace-link resolves to sampled request, and error classifications present for 24h without flapping. can do 30-min sessions to validate.

alex: acceptance gate proposal: (A) route economics present and within 8% for 80% high-volume routes; (B) compact error-slice (timeouts, 5xx, client-errors) per route; (C) trace-link verified by customer in acceptance session; (D) short runbook + release blurb. owners: tony impl, ben infra, sarah customer validation, maya comms.

tony: implementation estimate: spike 2d, implement 3d if we can reuse token-attribution; if we need tagging plumbing add +3d. ben: does that align?

ben: yep. reuse of nightly pipeline for attribution could work for MVP but we must surface confidence metrics (coverage %, missing-route rate) so customers understand caveats. I'll add coverage fields to the UI table.

ops-bot: INF ticket placeholder created by ben. Ops requires a short scope doc before approval.

maya: UI/UX note — keep table compact: route, calls, cost/day, avg latency, error-rate, coverage %. add small chevron to open trace-sample. keep it mobile-friendly for sales demos.

sarah: pilots also asked for a "batching impact demo" (approx cost delta if batching X per route). mark as stretch but demoable with conservative assumptions.

alex: split plan: MVP-1 = route cost table + error-slice + trace-link + runbook (pilot beta). MVP-2 = batching demo slider + sampling control UI + richer error breakdowns + SLA canary gating. target MVP-1 for next sprint end.

tony: opening spike card now. i'll attach pseudo-code and expected metrics: sample_bias_pct, coverage_pct, estimated_variance.

ben: i'll open infra ticket and request ephemeral validation cluster (r5.xlarge) for 72h. tagging billing for tag propagation.

maya: action items: tony (sampling spike + PR), ben (infra ticket + validation instance), sarah (schedule two 30m acceptance runs with pilots + pass/fail script), alex (stakeholder comms + contract hold note), maya (docs + SDK blurb). next check: Tue 10am sync to freeze acceptance tests.

alex: thanks team — priority: unblock customers this quarter. keep updates in the card and ping me for blockers. :rocket:
